p: mighty: The prophet shows that if princes and judges do not do their duty, God whose authority is above them will take vengeance on them.
wicked: For thieves and murderers find favour in judgment when the cause of the godly cannot be heard.
needy: Not only when they cry for help, but when their cause requires aid and support.
foundations of the earth are out: That is, all things are out of order either by their tyranny or careless negligence.
But ye shall die like men: No title of honour will excuse you, but you will be subject to God's judgments, and tender account as well as other men.
all nations: Therefore no tyrant will pluck your right and authority from you.
